## Partner v0.3.1

This update improves pet motion tuning, session storage, voice playback and settings reliability, and strengthens the build and release process.

- **Desktop pet:** Procedural motion, gaze and drag spring-back are applied before physics, allowing them to drive hair and other physics effects. Map parameters per model, adjust multipliers, add offset tracks and inspect diagnostics for saved settings. Window operation failures can be inspected and retried in settings.
- **Sessions:** Reads include only committed events and support concurrent history deletion. Projection after append and pet feed backlog reads are optimized. If replacing the log during history deletion fails, the store attempts to reopen the original and otherwise explicitly faults.
- **Voice:** Playback buffering is bounded by duration; interruption cancels the old reply and clears the buffer. After a device failure, save voice settings again to retry. Reference-audio uploads temporarily lock settings editing, saving and discarding.
- **Settings:** Whole-settings updates use a revision to detect concurrent changes. Engine detection fills the form; changes take effect after saving.
- **Engineering and releases:** Updated frontend development dependencies and split the settings panels, desktop shell and smoke checks. Tag validation, release permission isolation and pet-disabled build checks are stronger. Updates stop the API process tree first and restore supervision if the installer fails to start.

## Notes

- Pet diagnostics and previews use saved settings; model parameter mappings require manual confirmation. Sleeping does not currently slow breathing.
- Settings are read at API startup; restart after editing the file manually. On a revision conflict, reload and reconcile unsaved edits.
- Live2D Core and models remain user-supplied. See the [pet](https://github.com/Jaspersol/partner/blob/v0.3.1/doc/pet.en.md), [voice](https://github.com/Jaspersol/partner/blob/v0.3.1/doc/voice.en.md) and [release](https://github.com/Jaspersol/partner/blob/v0.3.1/doc/release.en.md) documentation.
